ActorTalk: Hmm... the first thing I think of is a flower with golden, cup-shaped petals.

It blooms in early spring, always turning toward the sun. Its petals are much warmer inside than the world around it. To pollinating insects, they're little heat lamps scattered across the snowfields.
In a way, I'm the same. I follow the light... and pass on the warmth and hope I've received.
